releaseNotes:
- Connected Servers Startup & Resume: Resolved an issue where backgrounding Plix or accessing Android TV settings could cause the app to reopen into the Connected Servers screen without a back button; Plix now seamlessly returns directly to the Home screen and provides graceful Home navigation fallbacks
- Connected Servers Information: Updated description to clearly explain multi-server connectivity and how favorite libraries configure the navigation menu
- Library Grid Highlight Border: Fixed top row item focus highlight border getting truncated at the top of full library screens
- App Version Bump: v1.8.2 (versionCode 44)
